memberdef.name: create

parameterdescription.para: The internal block size used by the PDB file. See isValidBlockSize() for a list of valid block sizes.

Causes the builder to reserve up front space for at least MinBlockCount blocks. This is useful when using MSFBuilder to read an existing MSF that you want to write back out later. The original MSF file's SuperBlock contains the exact number of blocks used by the file, so is a good hint as to how many blocks the new MSF file will contain. Furthermore, it is actually necessary in this case. To preserve stability of the file's layout, it is helpful to try to keep all streams mapped to their original block numbers. To ensure that this is possible, space for all blocks must be allocated beforehand so that streams can be assigned to them.

If true, any operation which results in an attempt to locate a free block when all available blocks have been exhausted will allocate a new block, thereby growing the size of the final MSF file. When false, any such attempt will result in an error. This is especially useful in testing scenarios when you know your test isn't going to do anything to increase the size of the file, so having an Error returned if it were to happen would catch a programming error

simplesect.para: an llvm::Error representing whether the operation succeeded or failed. Currently the only way this can fail is if an invalid block size is specified, or MinBlockCount does not leave enough room for the mandatory reserved blocks required by an MSF file.

briefdescription.para: Request the block map to be at a specific block address.

detaileddescription.para: This is useful when editing a MSF and you want the layout to be as stable as possible.

briefdescription.para: Add a stream to the MSF file with the given size, occupying the given list of blocks.

detaileddescription.para: This is useful when reading a MSF file and you want a particular stream to occupy the original set of blocks. If the given blocks are already allocated, or if the number of blocks specified is incorrect for the given stream size, this function will return an Error.

briefdescription.para: Add a stream to the MSF file with the given size, occupying any available blocks that the builder decides to use.

detaileddescription.para: This is useful when building a new PDB file from scratch and you don't care what blocks a stream occupies but you just want it to work.

briefdescription.para: Update the size of an existing stream.

detaileddescription.para: This will allocate or deallocate blocks as needed to match the requested size. This can fail if CanGrow was set to false when initializing the MSFBuilder.

briefdescription.para: Get the total number of streams in the MSF layout.

detaileddescription.para: This should return 1 for every call to addStream.

briefdescription.para: Get the size of a stream by index.
Get the list of blocks allocated to a particular stream.
Get the total number of blocks that will be allocated to actual data in this MSF file.
Get the total number of blocks that exist in the MSF file but are not allocated to any valid data.
Get the total number of blocks in the MSF file.

detaileddescription.para: In practice this is equal to getNumUsedBlocks() + getNumFreeBlocks().

briefdescription.para: Check whether a particular block is allocated or free.
Finalize the layout and build the headers and structures that describe the MSF layout and can be written directly to the MSF file.
Write the MSF layout to the underlying file.
